name: summarize-up-to
description: Summarize the conversation up to any point, inside long agent-driven turns too, keeping everything after it verbatim; optionally make auto-compaction do the same

compact_percent.title: Share to summarize on /compact (%)
compact_percent.description: Every plain /compact summarizes this share of the oldest conversation and keeps the rest verbatim, until you change it. A cut armed with /summarize-up-to overrides it once; /compact full summarizes everything. 0 makes a plain /compact summarize everything, as without the mod.

auto_compact.title: Partial auto-compaction
auto_compact.description: When Claude Code auto-compacts, summarize only the oldest share of the conversation and keep the rest verbatim. Set when it fires with /autocompact or CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE.

summarize_percent.title: Share to summarize (%)
summarize_percent.description: How much of the oldest conversation an auto-compaction summarizes; the rest stays verbatim.
